title: Smiling Mother with Baby in Stroller, 1968 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot from August 1968 depicting a young mother beaming next to her baby resting in a metal-framed stroller in a sunny backyard. The mother features a sculpted late-1960s bouffant hair flip style, reflecting mid-century suburban American family life and fashion trends.
